R1: UserRepo.get_by_email_locked/get_by_id_locked (FOR UPDATE) + clock_timestamp() close the login-vs-password-change race; a real deadlock was found and fixed during implementation (locking the row at the start of login() self-deadlocked against the existing separate-connection failed-login bookkeeping — fixed by locking only for a final re-verify after an apparent password match, never around the failure path).
